name: Cofle S.p.A.
summary: Cofle S.p.A. engages in the design, production, sale, and marketing of control cables and control systems worldwide. The company offers original equipment, such as cables, control systems, gearshift systems, steering columns and motion driving systems, die castings, sheet metals, and plastic products. It also provides control cables and brake hoses. Cofle S.p.A. was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Milan, Italy.
